usable_goal: One original editable paired ankle-boot artist source with a deliberately authored rounded toe, lace-up front, ankle shaft/rim, rear counter, dark low sole and modest separate heel. Save complete source/topology/OBJ and one actual front/profile/rear comparison if a fresh exact source passes. Unitless artist starting point only.
question: Is complete original nominal-foot-volume and boot-part authorship worth doing now to make the existing brown ankle-boot design editable in3D, without borrowing unqualified g050 foot data or claiming wearable fit?
decision: Nominate/refuse this complete original artist-source contract. Actual silhouette review can retain/refuse the resulting coarse boot source; it cannot qualify anatomical fit, a physical last, asset transfer or full character.

original_source_responsibility.frame: Explicit authored unitless local frame: x lateral, y up, z toe-forward; ground y0; source-relative left/right transforms and winding stated. All dimensions are deliberate artist choices, not measurements recovered from the perspective sheet or an anatomical foot.
original_source_responsibility.nominal_interface: Own a complete original closed nominal interior foot/ankle reference volume as part of the source. It is a fictional design envelope, not a real human foot/physical shoemaking last. Its full vertices/faces/part IDs and relation to upper interior/open rim and sole must be explicit, not selected from body joints or borrowed masks.
original_source_responsibility.entire_asset: Own every upper outer/inner cavity surface, rim join, bottom closure/interface, sole and heel surface and original left/right placement. Lace/front-tongue and rear-counter language must be named parts with explicit attachment/overlap intent. No hidden back or generic sole proxy standing in for missing boot source.
original_source_responsibility.joins_and_openings: Exact topology IDs for connected upper/inner cavity/rim and sole/heel boundaries; decorative parts may be separate, with explicit intended overlap, no silent manifold union/cloth claim. Paired source transform reflection must account for winding.
original_source_responsibility.appearance: One fixed three-view actual source render under a separately reviewed viewer; rounded forefoot, ankle shaft, low heel/sole and counter must read as the original brown lace-up boot. Coarse artist form can be retained; texture/laces/counter detail may remain open if actual view fails the intended reading.

scope_now: Read-only worth only: complete exact PLAN/hashes and actual original boot image. No source constructor/GLB decode/BIN values/skin arithmetic/data subset/metrics/geometry/build/import/native/browser/GPU/new capture/network/raster generation or assets/default/checklist edit.
future_gate: Only conditional worth. Fresh complete literal producer/checker/viewer/source contract and exact inputs require critic+root admission with separate finite deadline before any single CPU export/check or serialized native image. First source/test/render refusal stops this fixed authorship method; preserve actual bytes/streams/image, no tweaks/retry/retake or fallback.
